description: About Project Fihrist Project Fihrist is an interdisciplinary Universal Event team led by an undergraduate student in Physics and Informatics at Dushanbe Innovation Institute. Named after the classical concept of a comprehensive index (Fihrist)—and inspired by the intersection of historical astronomical scholarship, early spaceflight milestones, and modern computational science—our mission is to turn raw NASA open data into clear, interactive, and scientifically grounded tools.
